summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing its 2026 Corporate Value-up Plan, a voluntary shareholder return initiative. The plan sets a 35–40% payout ratio of adjusted controlling-interest net income for 2026–2028, commits to monetizing listed subsidiary stakes, and targets a PBR of 1.0 by 2028. The company also self-assesses as a high-dividend company under Article 104-27, noting stable KRW 10,000 dividends per share for 2024–2025, with a slight dividend amount decrease due to treasury share cancellations in August 2024. The plan includes mid-term investments of KRW 29.1 trillion through 2028. This is a forward-looking capital return policy announcement rather than a concrete transaction. Watch for execution of subsidiary stake sales and actual payout ratios versus targets.
